$comment: CURATED docs-map / knowledge graph for the x402-start skill. Hand-maintained routing + taxonomy. For the AUTHORITATIVE recommendable gate, read reference/capability.json (machine-generated by sync.sh) — it wins over the 'status' hints here. Route by this index instead of grepping the whole tree.

upto.note: sync-only: settles within the same HTTP response

auth-capture.note: SPEC-ONLY. No server SDK/example. NEVER recommend or generate. Re-enables automatically when a server example + @x402/evm/auth-capture/server land (sync.sh recomputes capability.json).

builder-code.note: The `.registerExtension(builderCodeResourceServerExtension)` form is shown ONLY in the canonical CDP file; examples/servers/builder-code shows the per-route declare form.

bazaar.note: output object with at least `example` is REQUIRED for indexing; schema optional (see pitfalls #2). `.registerExtension(bazaarResourceServerExtension)` is shown only in the canonical CDP file.

sign-in-with-x.autoInject: identity needed OR deferred-delivery (job id/poll/webhook/202) detected

payment-identifier.note: DECLARE-ONLY: applied per-route via declarePaymentIdentifierExtension + extractPaymentIdentifier. There is NO registerExtension server object — do not try to `.registerExtension(...)` it. See the example.

disambiguation.SIWX: = the sign-in-with-x extension (identifier: sign-in-with-x). Same thing; use the canonical identifier in code.
disambiguation.facilitator: CDP facilitator throughout: import { facilitator as cdpFacilitator } from '@coinbase/x402'; new HTTPFacilitatorClient(cdpFacilitator). NOT the keyless { url } form the generic examples use.
disambiguation.network: CAIP-2 ids only. Base Sepolia = eip155:84532 (default/testnet); Base mainnet = eip155:8453. Never bare 'base-sepolia' (that's v1).
disambiguation.asset: USDC by default (Base Sepolia USDC for the first run).
disambiguation.canonicalNextShape: examples/canonical-next-cdp/proxy.ts is the source of truth for CDP + Next 16 wiring. The bundled examples/fullstack/next uses an alternate helper API and the keyless facilitator — prefer the canonical file for the CDP shape.

v2Anchoring.migrationAsset: docs/guides/migration-v1-to-v2.mdx (keep for 'what not to do'; target is always v2)

validationTiers.T1: Always, zero-secret, offline-capable: 402 response shape + Bazaar output metadata check.
validationTiers.T2: Opt-in: real Base Sepolia + USDC verify+settle via CDP facilitator. Needs CDP_API_KEY_ID/SECRET + a funded Base Sepolia buyer wallet (see examples/clients + a faucet).
